value.message: Kids & Me at the Acton branch of Halton Hills Public Library is a free drop-in Thursdays 1-2:30pm for families with kids up to 6 - their site says. There's also an EarlyON Child and Family Centre in Acton & Georgetown for 0-6 year olds, free, though Links2Care's page doesn't list drop-in times. Want me to call and get their schedule?
